description: This file defines the CandidateHistory entity class for ORM mapping within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It models the history records related to candidate actions, including associations with candidates, vacancies, interviews, and employees, along with relevant properties like action type, date, and notes.

classes.name: CandidateHistory
classes.description: ORM-mapped entity class representing the history of candidate-related actions, with properties for candidate, vacancy, interview, performer, action, date, and notes, utilizing Doctrine annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the CandidateHistory record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the CandidateHistory record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Candidate object.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this history record.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Vacancy object, if any.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy object with this history record.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Gets the name of the vacancy related to the candidate for this record.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Sets the vacancy name associated with this candidate history.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Interview object, if any.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview object with this history record.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the integer code representing the action taken.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action code for this history record.

methods.name: getPerformedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who performed this action, if any.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Associates an Employee as the performer of this action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setPerformedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves the optional note associated with this history entry.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets a note for this history record.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Retrieves the interviewers string (deprecated).

methods.name: setInterviewers
methods.description: Sets the interviewers string (deprecated).
